name: the model names a Meal nobody handed it
note: FR-015 and the E2 finding said plainly: replaying meal-description against a real model caught it stating things the Cook never said, while three golden cases had marked all of it PASS. The same failure here names food nobody is cooking. Number 7 does not exist — two Meals were handed over — and the model has no way to check availability, so it is never given the opportunity. The out-of-range number is dropped and the real one survives.
